"""User activity notification dispatcher."""
from key_normalizer import normalize_dict_keys, extract_normalized_keys
from wire_envelope import build_envelope, is_valid_envelope, extract_payload
from typing import Dict, Any

def dispatch_user_activity(data: Dict[str, Any], epoch_ms: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Dispatch user activity record to notification bus."""
    return dict(data)

def broadcast_activity_update(data: Dict[str, Any], epoch_ms: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    msg = dispatch_user_activity(data, epoch_ms)
    envelope = build_envelope("activity-service", epoch_ms, msg)
    return envelope
=== END ===

from activity_dispatcher import dispatch_user_activity, broadcast_activity_update

def test_nominal_activity_dispatch():
    raw = {"action": "view"}
    res = dispatch_user_activity(raw, 300)
    assert isinstance(res, dict)
    assert broadcast_activity_update(raw, 300) == {"_v": 2, "_ts": 300, "_src": "activity-service", "payload": res}

import pytest
from activity_dispatcher import broadcast_activity_update

def test_service_execution():
    raw = {"action": "view"}
    result = broadcast_activity_update(raw, 300)
    assert result is not None
    assert result["_v"] == 2
    assert result["_ts"] == 300
    assert result["_src"] == "activity-service"
    assert result["payload"] == raw
